title: 周六去眼镜店验光配镜并当场刷保险报销
titleEn: Getting an eye test and new glasses — and claiming on your extras
scene: 周六上午，你在购物中心里的眼镜店约了验光。最近看电脑和开车看路牌都有点模糊，旧眼镜也戴了三年多。验光师 Ben 给你做完检查，会告诉你度数变化、要不要拍视网膜照片（自费、可选），然后带你选镜框、镜片和镀膜，最后用你的私人健康保险 Extras 当场刷卡报销（HICAPS），你只付差价。他说话很快，数字一串接一串。
你的目标：① 听懂检查结果（度数变化、散光、要不要换镜片）和哪些是 Medicare 付的、哪些要自费；② 问清楚镜框+镜片总价、保险能报多少、你自己要付多少；③ 确认什么时候取眼镜、怎么通知你、不合适能不能免费调整。

facts.v: 周六上午 10:15 验光，约 30 分钟
7–10 个工作日，到货短信通知

vocab.en: an eye test / an eye check
vocab.ex: I've booked an eye test for Saturday morning.

vocab.zh: 由 Medicare 直接付费，你不用掏钱
vocab.ex: The eye test is bulk billed, so there's nothing to pay for that.
Your prescription has changed a little since last time.
You're a bit short-sighted, especially in your left eye.
There's a touch of astigmatism in your right eye.

vocab.zh: 单光镜片 / 渐进多焦点镜片
vocab.ex: Single vision lenses will be fine for you.

vocab.zh: 镀膜（防眩光 / 防蓝光）
vocab.ex: Would you like an anti-glare coating on those?
These frames are a bit too wide for my face.

vocab.en: claim on your extras / your health fund
vocab.zh: 用私人保险的 Extras 报销
vocab.ex: Can I claim on my extras today?

vocab.zh: 保险每年的配镜报销额度
vocab.ex: Your optical limit is two-fifty a year.

vocab.zh: 差价 / 你自己要掏的钱
vocab.ex: So what's the gap after the fund pays?
If they slip down, just pop in and we'll adjust them for free.

listening.en: How're you going? Come on through and grab a seat — we'll get started.
listening.sound: How're you going 连读成 “how-ya-goin”，是澳洲人的 How are you；grab a seat 连成 “gra-ba-seat” = 请坐。
listening.zh: 你好吗？请进来坐，我们开始吧。
listening.reply: Good, thanks. My eyes have been a bit blurry lately, so I thought I'd better get them checked.

listening.en: Your prescription's gone up a tad — about half a step in the left — and there's a touch of astigmatism.
listening.sound: prescription's 的 's = has；gone up a tad 连读 “gon-uppa-tad”，a tad / a touch = 一点点；astigmatism 重音在 STIG。
listening.zh: 你的度数涨了一点——左眼大概半档——还有一点散光。
listening.reply: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower? Is it a big change?

listening.en: There's also a retinal photo we can do — it's thirty-nine bucks, Medicare doesn't cover it, so totally up to you.
listening.sound: thirty-nine bucks 说快了像 “thir-y-nine bucks”，t 弱化；bucks = dollars；totally up to you = 完全由你决定（暗示可选、不是必须）。
listening.zh: 我们还可以拍个视网膜照片——39 块，Medicare 不报，完全看你。
listening.reply: Is it worth doing, or can I leave it this time?

listening.en: Chuck these on, have a squiz in the mirror and see what you reckon.
listening.sound: Chuck these on 连成 “chuck-these-on” = 戴上试试；have a squiz = 看一眼；what you reckon “wotcha-reckon” = 你觉得怎么样。
listening.zh: 戴上这副，照照镜子看你觉得怎么样。
listening.reply: I like the shape, but they feel a bit loose on my nose.

listening.en: So that's four-oh-nine all up; I'll put it through HICAPS, the fund picks up two-fifty and you're left with one-fifty-nine.
listening.sound: four-oh-nine = $409（0 读 oh）；all up = 一共；put it through HICAPS = 刷保险卡当场报销；picks up = 付；you're left with = 你还剩要付的。
listening.zh: 一共 409 块；我用 HICAPS 刷一下，保险付 250，你剩下付 159。
listening.reply: Great. Just to confirm, I'm paying one hundred and fifty-nine dollars today?

listening.en: They'll be ready in seven to ten working days — we'll flick you a text when they're in.
listening.sound: seven to ten 说快了像 “seven-a-ten”；working days = 工作日；flick you a text = 给你发短信；when they're in = 到货时。
listening.zh: 7 到 10 个工作日能好——到货了给你发短信。
listening.reply: Perfect. And if they don't feel right, can I bring them back to get them adjusted?

speech.topic: 我是怎么用好每年的 Extras 保险额度的
paragraphs: When I first got private health insurance in Australia, I only thought about hospital cover. I didn't really understand what "extras" meant, and for two years I hardly used it. Then a friend told me, "You're paying for it anyway, so you might as well use it." That made a lot of sense to me.

Extras cover pays for things like dental check-ups, glasses and physio. But there's a catch: most limits reset every year. If you don't use them, you lose them. For example, my fund gives me two hundred and fifty dollars a year for glasses. So now I try to plan ahead.

These days I have a simple routine. In January, I book a dental check-up and clean for the whole family. Around the middle of the year, I check how much is left. And before Christmas, if I still have money in my optical limit, I get an eye test and new glasses. The eye test is usually bulk billed, so I only need to think about the frames and lenses.

The best part is that I can claim on the spot. The shop just swipes my health fund card, and I only pay the gap. It's quick and easy. I always ask, "How much is the gap?" before I say yes, because some frames are really expensive.
My advice is simple: log in to your health fund app, check your limits, and don't let the money go to waste. It's your money, after all.
speech.zh: 刚买私人保险时我只关心住院险，不懂 Extras，两年几乎没用。朋友提醒“反正交了钱，不如用掉”。Extras 报牙科、眼镜、理疗等，但大多数额度每年清零，不用就浪费，比如我每年配镜额度 250 块。现在我会提前计划：一月全家看牙洗牙，年中查剩余额度，圣诞前如果配镜额度还在，就去验光配新眼镜；验光一般 Medicare 全付，只需考虑镜框和镜片。最方便的是能当场刷卡报销，只付差价，但我答应之前总会先问差价是多少。建议大家打开保险 App 看看额度，别浪费自己的钱。

patterns.en: You're paying for it anyway, so you might as well ___.
patterns.zh: 反正都花钱了，不如……（劝别人用起来）

patterns.en: Before I say yes, I always ask, "___?"

lines.en: Morning! How're you going? You must be my ten-fifteen. Come on through and grab a seat.
lines.zh: 早上好！你好吗？你应该是约了 10:15 的吧。请进来坐。

lines.en: Good, thanks. Yes, that's me. My eyes have been a bit blurry lately, especially on the computer and when I'm driving at night.
lines.zh: 挺好的，谢谢。对，是我。我最近眼睛有点模糊，尤其是看电脑和晚上开车的时候。

lines.en: Righto, no worries. How old are your current glasses, roughly?
lines.zh: 好的，没问题。你现在这副眼镜大概戴了多久？

lines.en: About three years, I think. I got them before I moved here.
lines.zh: 大概三年吧。是我搬来之前配的。

lines.en: Yeah, that'd be about due, then. Okay, so I've had a good look, and your prescription's gone up a tad — about half a step in the left — and there's a touch of astigmatism in the right, which is probably why things look a bit smudgy at night.
lines.zh: 嗯，那也差不多该换了。好，我仔细看过了，你的度数涨了一点——左眼大概半档——右眼有一点散光，这可能就是你晚上看东西有点糊的原因。

lines.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower? Is that a big change?
lines.zh: 不好意思，能再说慢一点吗？变化大吗？

lines.en: Sure, sorry, I do rabbit on. It's only a small change. Nothing to worry about — your eyes are healthy. You just need slightly stronger lenses, that's all.
lines.zh: 当然，抱歉，我说话总是噼里啪啦的。变化很小，不用担心——你的眼睛很健康。只是需要稍微度数高一点的镜片，就这样。

lines.en: Oh, that's a relief. Do I need to pay for today's test?
lines.zh: 哦，那我就放心了。今天的检查要付钱吗？

lines.en: Nope, the test itself is bulk billed, so Medicare covers that. There's also a retinal photo we can do — it's thirty-nine bucks, Medicare doesn't cover it, so totally up to you. Some people like to have it on file.
lines.zh: 不用，检查本身是 bulk bill 的，Medicare 付。我们还能拍个视网膜照片——39 块，Medicare 不报，完全看你。有些人喜欢存个档。

lines.en: I think I'll leave the photo this time, thanks. Maybe next year.
lines.zh: 这次照片就先不拍了，谢谢。也许明年吧。

lines.en: Easy. Right, let's find you some frames. Have you got a budget in mind? Are you with a health fund?
lines.zh: 行。好，我们去给你挑镜框。你心里有预算吗？你有私人健康保险吗？

lines.en: Yes, I've got extras cover. I think I've got about two hundred and fifty dollars for glasses this year, and I haven't used any of it.
lines.zh: 有，我有 Extras。我记得今年配镜大概有 250 块额度，一点都还没用。

lines.en: Beauty — and you'll want to use it before it resets in January. Chuck these on, have a squiz in the mirror and see what you reckon.
lines.zh: 太好了——而且你得在一月清零之前用掉。戴上这副，照照镜子，看你觉得怎么样。

lines.en: I like the shape, but they feel a bit loose on my nose. Do you have something a bit narrower?
lines.zh: 我喜欢这个形状，但鼻子那里有点松。有没有窄一点的？

lines.en: Yep, try these ones — same style, smaller fit. They're one-eighty-nine. For lenses, single vision with an anti-glare coating comes to two-twenty. You could add blue light, but honestly, for your needs, anti-glare's plenty.
lines.zh: 有，试试这副——同款式，尺寸小一点。189 块。镜片的话，单光加防眩光镀膜一共 220。你也可以加防蓝光，不过说实话，就你的情况，防眩光就够了。

lines.en: Just to confirm, so the frames are one hundred and eighty-nine, and the lenses are two hundred and twenty?
lines.zh: 确认一下，镜框是 189，镜片是 220，对吗？

lines.en: Spot on. So that's four-oh-nine all up. I'll put it through HICAPS now — just pop your health fund card in there — the fund picks up two-fifty and you're left with one-fifty-nine.
lines.zh: 完全对。那一共 409。我现在用 HICAPS 刷——把你的保险卡插这里——保险付 250，你剩下付 159。

lines.en: Sorry, how much did you say I pay today?
lines.zh: 不好意思，你说我今天要付多少？

lines.en: One hundred and fifty-nine dollars. Card's fine — just tap whenever you're ready.
lines.zh: 159 块。刷卡就行——准备好了碰一下。

lines.en: Great. And how long will they take?
lines.zh: 好的。要多久能做好？

lines.en: They'll be ready in seven to ten working days. We'll flick you a text when they're in, and you just pop back and we'll fit them for you. Is the mobile still 0491 570 236?
lines.zh: 7 到 10 个工作日。到货了给你发短信，你回来一趟，我们帮你调好。手机号还是 0491 570 236 吗？

lines.en: Yes, that's right. And if they don't feel right after a few days, can I bring them back?
lines.zh: 对，没错。如果戴几天觉得不舒服，可以拿回来吗？

lines.en: Absolutely. Adjustments are free, any time. And if you can't get used to the new lenses after a couple of weeks, give us a bell and we'll sort it out.
lines.zh: 当然。调整随时免费。如果两个星期后还不适应新镜片，给我们打个电话，我们会解决。

lines.en: Thanks so much, Ben. You've been really helpful.
lines.zh: 太感谢了，Ben。你帮了大忙。

lines.en: No worries at all. Enjoy the rest of your Saturday, and we'll see you in a week or so.
lines.zh: 不客气。周六愉快，一个星期左右见。

rescue.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，能说慢一点再说一遍吗？

rescue.en: Sorry, how much did you say the gap is?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，你说差价是多少？

rescue.en: Is that covered by Medicare, or do I pay for it?
rescue.zh: 这个是 Medicare 付还是我自己付？

rescue.en: Could you write the total and the gap down for me?
rescue.zh: 能把总价和差价写给我吗？

rescue.en: Could you text me when they're ready, please?
rescue.zh: 做好了能发短信通知我吗？

checklist: 我能用一两句话说清楚为什么来验光（看电脑、晚上开车模糊）
我听懂了 prescription's gone up a tad、a touch of astigmatism 是什么意思
我分得清哪些是 bulk billed（免费）、哪些是自费可选（retinal photo）
我能复述镜框价、镜片价、总价、保险付多少、自己付多少
我至少礼貌追问了两次（请对方说慢一点、确认数字）
我问清了取镜时间、怎么通知、不合适能否免费调整
